json.name: JSON text
json.definition: A JSON text as defined by RFC 8259 / ECMA-404, read from local bytes, a string, a file or a stream into values or parse events.
json.in_scope: DOM, streaming/event, and data-binding parsers that tokenize JSON text themselves or through an identified family.
json.out_of_scope: Encoders/serializers only, schema validators or JSONPath/JMESPath layers without their own parse step (they inherit a parser family), CLI-only tools, remote services.
json.ambiguity: JSON5, Hjson, JSONC and UCL parsers accept supersets; only the strict-JSON control subset can be claimed. Wrappers over a runtime parser (JSON.parse, json_decode, encoding/json) share that family.

xml.name: XML 1.0 document
xml.definition: A well-formed XML 1.0 document with namespaces, read from local bytes, a string, a file or a stream into a tree or event stream.
xml.in_scope: DOM, SAX, StAX/pull and tree parsers; object mappers count only with their tokenizer family identified.
xml.out_of_scope: Writers/builders only, HTML-only parsers, XSLT/XPath layers without their own tokenizer, binary XML encodings, CLI-only tools.
xml.ambiguity: Many wrappers delegate to Expat, libxml2, encoding/xml or a JDK SAX/StAX provider; family must be recorded. HTML parsers with an XML mode (htmlparser2, jsoup) are flagged.

mp3_plain.name: Plain untagged MP3
mp3_plain.definition: An MPEG-1 or MPEG-2 (LSF) Audio Layer III elementary stream (ISO/IEC 11172-3, ISO/IEC 13818-3) consisting only of contiguous audio frames: no ID3v1, ID3v2 or APE tag and no Xing/Info/VBRI header frame. A parser must interpret frame headers (sync, version, layer, bitrate, sample rate, channel mode) or decode samples.
mp3_plain.in_scope: Frame parsers, duration/property scanners that read frame headers, and PCM decoders.
mp3_plain.out_of_scope: ID3-only or other tag-only readers, MIME/magic sniffing, external-process wrappers (ffmpeg/lame CLIs), encoders only.
mp3_plain.relation_to_mp3_id3v2: The existing mp3_id3v2 cell tests tagged files; a parser verified there through ID3 fields does not establish frame-level MP3 parsing. Verification here needs a frame-level observable on an untagged control. Tagging libraries that also scan frame headers (mutagen, TagLib, jaudiotagger, getID3, mp3agic) remain leads until that frame-level result is shown.
mp3_plain.ambiguity: MPEG-2.5 (8/11.025/12 kHz) is a non-ISO extension and is not used by the controls. Header-only scanners and full decoders produce different observables; the verified observable must be named per path.
